metadata.title: Clicked like a headless chicken and somehow clutched 2 kills? Valorant’s broken logic strikes again!
metadata.description:
Me: panicking like I lost all skill
Enemies: probably hitting uninstall right now
Valorant just handed me 2 accidental gifts—no clue how!
Click if your chaos clicks ever shock even you!

Hit like if your aim’s a beautiful disaster too!
